plugins.name: claudex-loop
plugins.description: Four-phase plan hardening: recon → interrogate → adversarial Codex review → cross-model build & inspection. Ships claudex-loop, plan-review (plan gate), build, code-review (acceptance gate), docs-backfill (documentation backfill), audit (first pass over an unreviewed codebase) and setup (wires a repo up) — plus the cross-platform read-only Codex wrapper and the PreToolUse guard that stops an allowlisted wrapper call from carrying a second command.
